name: finos-reference-tools
description: Independent community AIGF, CDM and FDC3 reference tools. Processes tool inputs locally; writes local audit metadata. Startup downloads locked dependencies with uv. See README for privacy and support.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only AIGF, CDM and FDC3 tools
interface.longDescription: Explore AI governance controls, validate Common Domain Model documents, and check FDC3 contexts and intents using independently maintained local MCP servers. Not an official FINOS product.
defaultPrompt: Find AIGF controls for prompt injection and cite their IDs.
Describe the CDM TradeState type and its schema.
